name: Abyssal Disciple
body:
The chosen ones of demon lords take their fiendish powers to a new level, unleashing havoc on the lands of the living and transforming in the end into demons in their own right.

Requirements

To qualify to become an abyssal disciple, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Race: Cannot be a creature with the chaotic or evil subtypes or with the fiendish, half-fiend, or half-demon templates.
Alignment: Chaotic evil.
Skills: Knowledge (planes) 5 ranks.
Languages: Abyssal.
Spellcasting: Able to cast bull’s strength. A sorcerer or bloodrager with this prestige class must have the abyssal bloodline. If the character gains levels of sorcerer or bloodrager after taking this class, she must take the abyssal bloodline.
Class Skills

The abyssal disciple’s class skills are Climb (Str), Fly (Dex), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (planes, religion) (Int), Perception (Wis), Survival (Wis), and Swim (Str).

Skill Ranks at Each Level: 2 + Int modifier.

Hit Die: d10.

Table 6: Abyssal Disciple
Level	Base Attack Bonus	Fort Save	Ref Save	Will Save	Special	Spells per Day
1st	+0	+1	+0	+1	Aura of chaos and evil, blood of the abyss, natural armor increase +1	—
2nd	+1	+1	+1	+1	Ability boost (Str +2), bloodline feat, demonic claws	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
3rd	+2	+2	+1	+2	Demon form (1/day)	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
4th	+3	+2	+1	+2	Ability boost (Str +2), natural armor increase +2	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
5th	+3	+3	+2	+3	Bloodline feat, darkvision 30 ft.	—
6th	+4	+3	+2	+3	Ability boost (Con +2)	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
7th	+5	+4	+2	+4	Demon form (2/day), natural armor increase +3	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
8th	+6	+4	+3	+4	Ability boost (Wis +2), bloodline feat	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
9th	+6	+5	+3	+5	Wings of the abyss	—
10th	+7	+5	+3	+5	Demon form (3/day), darkvision 60 ft.	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
Class Features

All of the following are class features of the abyssal disciple prestige class.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

Abyssal disciples gain no proficiency with any weapon or armor.

Spells per Day

At the indicated levels, an abyssal disciple gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in a spellcasting class he belonged to before adding the prestige class. He does not, however, gain other benefits a character of that class would have gained, except for additional spells per day, spells known (if he is a spontaneous spellcaster), and an increased effective level of spellcasting. If a character had more than one spellcasting class before becoming an abyssal disciple, he must decide to which class he adds the new level for purposes of determining spells per day.

Aura of Chaos and Evil (Ex)

The power of an abyssal disciple’s aura of chaos and evil is equal to his cleric and/or antipaladin level (if any) plus his abyssal disciple level.

Blood of the Abyss: An abyssal disciple adds his level to his sorcerer or bloodrager levels when determining the powers gained from his bloodline. A character with levels in both bloodrager and sorcerer must choose which class stacks with his abyssal disciple levels to determine his bloodline powers. If he does not have levels in sorcerer or bloodrager, he instead gains bloodline powers of the abyssal sorcerer bloodline, using his abyssal disciple level as his sorcerer level to determine the bonuses gained. This ability does not grant bonus spells to a sorcerer or bloodrager unless he possesses spell slots of an appropriate level. Such bonus spells are automatically granted if the sorcerer or bloodrager gains spell slots of the spell’s level.

Natural Armor Increase (Ex)

At 1st, 4th, and 7th level, an abyssal disciple’s skin toughens, causing a cumulative increase to his natural armor bonus of +1.

Ability Boost

As his body takes on the attributes of a demon, an abyssal disciple gains stat boosts as noted on Table 6: Abyssal Disciple. These increases stack and are gained as if through level advancement.

Bloodline Feat

Upon reaching 2nd level, and every three levels thereafter, an abyssal disciple receives one bonus feat, chosen from the sorcerer abyssal bloodline’s bonus feat list or from the bloodrager abyssal bloodline’s bonus feat list, depending on which one he is advancing with his level progression.

Demonic Claws (Su)

At 2nd level, the claws gained by the abyssal disciple through his first-level bloodline power increase their damage by 1 step (as per Improved Natural Attack) and the abyssal disciple adds 1-1/2 his Strength bonus to the damage dealt.

Darkvision (Ex)

At 5th level, the abyssal disciple gains darkvision with a range of 30 feet. If he already possessed darkvision, the ability range increases by 30 feet instead. At 10th level, the abyssal disciple adds another 30 feet to his darkvision range.

Demonic Form (Sp)

At 4th level, an abyssal disciple can assume some characteristics of demons once per day. This ability works like lesser proxy aspect (demons only). At 7th level, this ability functions as proxy aspect and can be used twice per day; at 10th level, it functions as greater proxy aspect and the abyssal disciple can use this ability three times per day. His caster level for this effect is equal to his effective sorcerer or bloodrager levels for his abyssal bloodline.

Wings of the Abyss (Su)

At 9th level, an abyssal disciple gains the wings of the abyss ability of the brutal bloodline, even if he doesn’t normally possess that power. Once his level is high enough to grant this ability through the bloodline, the abyssal disciple’s fly speed increases by 30 feet.
